messages:
maria_cs: Kestrel trial hitting repeated 429s on SDK init after we enabled ephemeral tokens. They do parallel preflight from multiple mounts (6x).

maria_cs: Sample log: ```2026-04-10T11:02:14Z WARN preflight status=429 client=kestrel-web body=\"rate_limited\"```

sam_eng: sounds like preflight fanout + token churn. short fixes: 1) splay requests (50-500ms), 2) cache/reuse token for 10-15s, 3) honor Retry-After and backoff.

elliot_support: I'll draft a 15m playbook and offer a live walkthrough.

maria_cs: customer asked for a demo today at 16:30 PT. can we also get a temporary tenant quota bump?

sam_eng: I'll prepare a tiny client patch to sequentialize preflight with jitter. snippet: ```js
const jitter = () => Math.random()*450 + 50;
for (let i=0;i<6;i++) setTimeout(preflight, Math.floor(jitter()*i));
```

deploybot: note: recent token-cache tweak deployed 2026-04-10T10:40Z. no flags toggled. SRE can apply a short quota increase on request.

maria_cs: opening SRE ticket SRE-8980 and requesting expedited approval. invite sent for 16:30 PT session.

elliot_support: playbook will include: identify callers, reduce parallelism, add local cache 15s, add jitter/backoff, monitor 429s in console.

sam_eng: during the call I'll show pre/post 429 telemetry and capture sample headers.

maria_cs: thanks all — will update ticket with logs and customer consent. :white_check_mark:
